selection_rule: Among candidates with validation answered_accuracy >=0.70 and coverage >=0.20, select highest unconditional accuracy, then answered_accuracy, then deterministic semantic for a tie. If none qualify, select highest answered_accuracy among policies answering at least8/40. No selection or prediction tuning on final100.
development_notes: Initial model-only30-doc pilot and initial rule scores preserved in reports/*-initial.json.

Correctness audit before final evaluation fixed year-valued observations misclassified as headers. Early deterministic validation summaries were viewed before this independent edge-case fix; candidates were then rerun on the same40 training validation documents. Validation is a policy selection set, not an untouched test.
interactive_default_constraint: The normal browser/launcher must work without a model server. SemanticBaseline is the new deterministic candidate; choose it as interactive default if it meets the same validation quality/coverage thresholds. LLM policies require explicit CLI selection regardless of global candidate ranking.
